meta_description_en: Brief overview of the SQ Tracker Compiler utility from the Austrian magazine Scene+ #33.
meta_description_ru: Краткая аннотация компилятора музыки SQ Tracker Compiler из австрийского журнала Scene+ #33.
body_de_plain:
SQ ü - SQ TRACKER COMPILER - Schon einige Musikstücke mit dem SQ
Tracker erstellt? Dann wirdes Zeit um diese endlich zu
compilieren, was mit diesem Programmrecht gut geht. Wieder mal
ist Thomas und seine Anleitunggefragt. H - Do you wrote some
music with the SQ Tracker? then it is time tocompile them now,
and this programm does the whole work for
body_en:
# SQ Tracker Compiler

Have you already created some music tracks with SQ-Tracker? Then it is time to finally compile them, which works quite well with this program. Once again, Thomas and his instructions are in demand.
